svg.title: Capabilities: RAG pipelines — Ingestion, chunking, hybrid retrieval and evaluation over messy business data.; Agentic systems — Tool-using agents and multi-step workflows with guardrails and explicit state.; MCP servers — Internal tools and data exposed to LLMs through the Model Context Protocol.; Document AI — OCR and structured extraction from scanned and semi-structured documents.; Evals & fine-tuning — Measured pipelines: per-stage evals, regressions caught, models tuned.; Enterprise integration — LLMs wired into real systems: auth, compliance, CI/CD, payments.
svg.text: to LLMs through the Model Context
